pm_active.meaning: executeHedge() is invoked while the HyperLiquid PM integration is active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot token bought by executeHedge

accounting_reads_revert_observed.meaning: totalBackingSigned(), surplus(), distributableSurplus() and settleDailyPnL gate 3 all revert
accounting_reads_revert_observed.checkpoint: after executeHedge registration and subsequent accounting read

assumptions: executeHedge() buys the spot asset on L1 and registers it in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply before the accounting reads occur.
The accounting reads are evaluated over the vaultSupplied registry that includes the registered spot token.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact failure response or revert condition enforced by suppliedBalance beyond a hard requirement on the 0x811 response; the revert is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome.
Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is authorized.

limitations: The four accounting reads and settleDailyPnL gate 3 are collapsed into one grounded Boolean outcome symbol rather than separate per-function observables.
The scenario is conditional on PM active and no BLP reserve; the report does not establish that executeHedge was actually invoked in a real transaction.
